heard: A rosy meteorite holds altered crust from ancient Mars. It weighed 800 grams after traveling through deep space. Zircon crystals inside dated the rock to 4 billion years. Volcanic minerals were altered by liquid water on that planet. Scientists identified 13 possible origin sites for the rock's journey. A reviewer named this specimen a rosetta stone for Mars. That ancient crust remains safely tucked inside our desert sands.
